# Incidents

| Date | Summary | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-21 | Editing files directly on master causes merge conflicts when merging worktrees. Always use work-start and work inside the worktree. | [detail](../../references/incidents/master-direct-edit-causes-merge-conflict.md) |
| 2026-05-23 | Designing skills to load other skills in Step 0 consumes 2,500×N tokens per invocation and bloats the context. Embed decision knowledge in the skill's own References section. | [detail](../../references/incidents/skill-reading-token-cost.md) |
| 2026-05-23 | Multiple skills were maintaining the same decision criteria inline, creating duplication. Consolidate shared knowledge for creator skills in `references/` and reference it from each skill. | [detail](../../references/incidents/creator-skill-inline-duplication.md) |
| 2026-05-24 | The merge skill auto-executed `git merge` without explicit user instruction. Even if permission was granted earlier in the session, each merge requires a separate instruction. Fix: added Critical Prohibition section to SKILL.md and an absolute-prohibition rule to Step 6. | [detail](../../references/incidents/merge-auto-execution-without-permission.md) |
| 2026-05-24 | The `.work/specs/` folder name implied official specifications, causing it to be treated as important documentation even though it is not auto-loaded by AI, leading to it becoming stale. Use an informal name like `notes/` for folders not auto-loaded by AI. | [detail](../../references/incidents/work-folder-name-implies-official-docs.md) |
| 2026-05-24 | The merge skill called conversation-to-claude from the master cwd, so generated glossary/incidents were committed directly to master instead of being included in the PR branch. Fix: cd to the worktree before delegating. Lesson: explicitly control cwd when delegating to skills that run git commit. | [detail](../../references/incidents/conversation-to-claude-master-direct-commit.md) |
| 2026-05-24 | Validating JP warning comments with `head -5` caused files with frontmatter (warning at line 7+) to be falsely detected as missing the warning, inflating the count to 39 instead of the actual 25. When checking file-header metadata, skip frontmatter and inspect the start of the body. | [detail](../../references/incidents/header-check-misses-frontmatter-files.md) |
| 2026-05-24 | Creating `hooks/prompts/*.md` with hook-creator did not create `*.jp.md` JP mirrors. The `skill-jp-mirror-sync.md` rule only covered SKILL.md, not hook prompts. Fix: added `hook-prompts-jp-mirror-sync.md` rule. | [detail](../../references/incidents/hook-prompts-jp-mirror-missing.md) |
| 2026-05-24 | When extracting a skill step into a standalone skill, a PR that already modified the same step existed on master, requiring two master-sync rounds after implementation. Before extracting a step, check recent changes with `git log --oneline master -- {file}`. | [detail](../../references/incidents/extract-step-check-master-first.md) |
| 2026-05-24 | Editing `CLAUDE.md` without updating the `CLAUDE.jp.md` JP mirror. Neither `skill-jp-mirror-sync.md` nor `hook-prompts-jp-mirror-sync.md` covered CLAUDE.md. Fix: added `claude-md-jp-mirror-sync.md` rule. | [detail](../../references/incidents/claude-md-jp-mirror-missing.md) |
| 2026-05-24 | Editing `incidents.md` / `glossary.md` without updating the `rules-jp/` JP mirrors, leaving them out of sync for a long time. Fix: added `incidents-glossary-jp-mirror-sync.md` rule to enforce same-commit updates. | [detail](../../references/incidents/incidents-glossary-jp-mirror-missing.md) |
| 2026-05-24 | When multiple Stop hooks fire simultaneously, `"Read and follow: /path"` instructions are disabled by the `stop_hook_active` guard. Claude executes direct instructions (e.g. notify-aituber) first and re-Stops; on the second firing all hooks are skipped because stop_hook_active=true, so indirect-reference instructions are never executed. Fix: reverted to embedding file content directly in reason/stdout. | [detail](../../references/incidents/stop-hook-multiple-block-race-condition.md) |
| 2026-05-24 | When batch-changing hook patterns in PR115, work-kit/dev-kit/ui-kit were updated but 5 UserPromptSubmit and 1 PostToolUse entries in claude-kit/hooks.json were missed. Lesson: before a cross-plugin hook pattern change, verify all plugins with `grep -r "<pattern>" --include="*.json" .`. | [detail](../../references/incidents/hook-pattern-change-missed-plugin.md) |
| 2026-05-25 | Inside a `python -c "..."` status-line command, the double-quotes in `r5["resets_at"]` broke the outer shell string, causing a NameError the moment rate_limits.resets_at appeared and crashing the status line. Fix: changed to `r5.get('resets_at')` using only single quotes. | [detail](../../references/incidents/statusline-python-quote-nesting.md) |
| 2026-05-25 | Running `apply-statusline.py` with WSL Python while Claude Code runs natively on Windows caused a different settings.json to be overwritten, so changes were never applied (no error either). Lesson: scripts using `Path.home()` must run in the same Python environment as Claude Code. | [detail](../../references/incidents/path-home-cross-env-mismatch.md) |
| 2026-05-24 | The `skill-creator-dispatch` hook only covered `UserPromptSubmit`, so Claude directly edited `SKILL.md` on ambiguous prompts. Fix: added `PreToolUse` block-type hooks to 4 plugins (claude-kit/dev-kit/ui-kit/work-kit). Lesson: file-type guards must be implemented as `PreToolUse` hooks, not `UserPromptSubmit`. | [detail](../../references/incidents/skill-creator-dispatch-userpromptsubmit-only.md) |
| 2026-05-25 | Claude started editing files directly on master despite a UserPromptSubmit hook explicitly stating that work-start must be run first. Hook instructions are a prerequisite for any implementation and must never be skipped, even for small changes. | [detail](../../references/incidents/work-start-skipped-despite-hook-instruction.md) |
| 2026-05-25 | `incidents.md` and `glossary.md` in `.claude/rules/core/` — the English originals always loaded by Claude — had all content written in Japanese, making them identical to their JP mirrors. Fix: rewrote all content in English (PR123). Rule: English-original rule files must contain only English. | [detail](../../references/incidents/core-rules-jp-content-in-en-file.md) |
| 2026-05-25 | skill-creator-dispatch PreToolUse was added to all 4 plugins (PR121), but claude-kit already guards SKILL.md globally — dev-kit/ui-kit/work-kit copies were redundant duplicates. Fix: removed from the 3 non-central plugins (PR124). Lesson: global guard hooks belong only in claude-kit; other plugins should add only plugin-specific hooks. | [detail](../../references/incidents/duplicate-hooks-in-non-claude-kit-plugins.md) |
| 2026-05-27 | When creating a JP mirror agent file with YAML frontmatter, the `<!-- Generated by -->` stamp was omitted and the JP mirror warning was placed before the frontmatter instead of after. Fix: always invoke `mark-generated`; insert the returned comment block immediately after the closing `---` of frontmatter, never before it. | [detail](../../references/incidents/agent-jp-mirror-stamp-before-frontmatter.md) |
| 2026-05-27 | In a policy-only PR (PR138, with implementation deferred to a follow-up PR), AI included detailed Python pseudocode of the hook in the design QA. User sharply corrected: don't write implementation detail in policy QA. Lesson: when a PR is scoped to "policy / design only", QA must stop at *what / why / where*, never *how*. | [detail](../../references/incidents/design-qa-implementation-creep.md) |
